name: Setup Action Files

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/setup-actions.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  setup-actions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Create KSU variant action files
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # wksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/wksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/wksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/wksu/action.yml'

        # next
        mkdir -p .github/actions/next
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/next/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/next/action.yml'

        # ksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/ksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/ksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/ksu/action.yml'

        # mksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/mksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/mksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/mksu/action.yml'

        # kowxu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/kowxu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/kowxu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/kowxu/action.yml'

        # resukisu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/resukisu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/resukisu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/resukisu/action.yml'

        # susfs-wksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-wksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-wksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-wksu/action.yml'

        # susfs-next
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-next
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-next/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-next/action.yml'

        # susfs-ksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-ksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-ksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-ksu/action.yml'

        # susfs-mksu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-mksu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-mksu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-mksu/action.yml'

        # susfs-kowxu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-kowxu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-kowxu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-kowxu/action.yml'

        # susfs-resukisu
        mkdir -p .github/actions/susfs-resukisu
        echo '' | base64 -d > .github/actions/susfs-resukisu/action.yml
        echo 'Created .github/actions/susfs-resukisu/action.yml'

    - name: Commit and Push Actions
      shell: bash
      run: |
        git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
        git config user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
        git add .github/actions/
        if git diff --cached --quiet; then
          echo 'No changes to commit'
        else
          git commit -m 'ci: setup KSU variant action files'
          git push
        fi
